requirements.quote: If the version selected by the client is not acceptable to the server, the server responds with a Version Negotiation packet; see Section 17.2.1.
requirements.condition: The version selected by the client is not acceptable to the server.
requirements.required_behavior: The server sends a Version Negotiation packet in response.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can send a packet using a version the server does not accept and verify that the response is a Version Negotiation packet.

requirements.quote: This includes a list of versions that the server will accept.
requirements.condition: The server sends a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The packet includes a list of versions that the server accepts.
requirements.why_checkable: The response packet can be decoded and its advertised version list compared with the versions accepted by the server.

requirements.quote: An endpoint MUST NOT send a Version Negotiation packet in response to receiving a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.condition: An endpoint receives a Version Negotiation packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint sends a Version Negotiation packet as a response.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver a Version Negotiation packet and observe whether the endpoint emits another Version Negotiation packet in response.

requirements.quote: Though either the Initial packet or the Version Negotiation packet that is sent in response could be lost, the client will send new packets until it successfully receives a response or it abandons the connection attempt.
requirements.condition: The client has not successfully received a response and has not abandoned the connection attempt, including when an Initial or responding Version Negotiation packet is lost.
requirements.required_behavior: The client continues sending new packets until it either successfully receives a response or abandons the connection attempt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The client permanently stops sending packets while the connection attempt remains active and no response has been successfully received.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss-injection test can drop Initial or Version Negotiation packets and verify continued client transmissions until one of the stated terminal conditions occurs.

requirements.quote: A server MAY limit the number of Version Negotiation packets it sends.
requirements.condition: A server is sending Version Negotiation packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation permits the server to impose a limit on the number of Version Negotiation packets it sends.
requirements.why_checkable: A configured packet limit can be exercised by repeatedly triggering Version Negotiation and checking that transmissions stop at the configured bound.
